# mirrors.ijosh.com

> Fast, verified mirrors of popular open-source software, synced on a
> schedule by open pipelines and served on Cloudflare's global network.
> Run by Josh Vaughen (https://ijosh.com).

## Mirrors

- CTAN: https://ctan.ijosh.com/ (upstream: https://ctan.org)
- TeX Live (tlnet): https://tlnet.ijosh.com/ (upstream: https://ctan.org/tex-archive/systems/texlive/tlnet)

## Source

- Sync pipelines and site: https://github.com/jshvn
